[SWS_DM_00414] Check supported DataIdentifier on active security level
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), a requested
DataIdentifier shall be considered as supported on active security level if and only if
the DataIdentifier is supported according to [SWS_DM_00409] and the active security
level passes the execution permission check as per [SWS_DM_00103].
⌋
